summary: Frontend-only verification of the login UI updates for Budget Mitra. All 9 requested checks pass: tank-farm background loads (200) and is set inline on .login-shell via PUBLIC_URL; ed-photo.jpg loads (200) with naturalWidth=360; leadership-message card is fully visible at 1600x900 (top=634, bottom=814, vh=900, fullyVisible=true); ed-portrait renders the actual photo (not User icon fallback); change-ed-photo-button opens hidden file input; setInputFiles on ed-photo-input successfully replaces portrait src with data:image/png;base64,... and persists to localStorage['bm_ed_photo'] (71,450 chars); reset-ed-photo-button appears after upload, restores default /logos/ed-photo.jpg and clears localStorage; rupee-badge animation='float-emblem', ::before='pulse-glow'; fonts are Sora + Manrope; login flow with BM-2024-001/budgetmitra reaches dashboard-page and logout-button returns to login screen.
critical_code_review_comments: Review request referenced [data-testid=login-button] and [data-testid=employee-id-input] but actual testids are login-submit-button and employee-number-input — keep this naming consistent in future test specs (not a bug, just doc mismatch).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is fully mocked. Login testids: employee-number-input, password-input, login-submit-button, logout-button, dashboard-page. Photo upload testids: ed-portrait, change-ed-photo-button, ed-photo-input, reset-ed-photo-button. localStorage key 'bm_ed_photo' stores custom uploaded data URL.
rca of the issue: N/A — all requested behaviours verified working.
